teacher.title: Complete teacher onboarding
teacher.description: Complete required teaching and platform onboarding.

completion.evidenceDescription: Onboarding completion recorded by an authorized administrator.

teachingAssistant.title: Complete Teaching Assistant onboarding
teachingAssistant.description: Complete required support and platform onboarding.

completion.evidenceDescription: Onboarding completion recorded by an authorized administrator.

teacher.title: Deliver five learning sessions
teacher.description: Deliver five completed sessions during the active season.

teachingAssistant.title: Support ten learning sessions
teachingAssistant.description: Provide verified support in ten completed sessions during the active season.

teacher.title: Maintain strong learner feedback
teacher.description: Reach an average feedback score of at least 4.2 out of 5 with the configured minimum response count.

teachingAssistant.title: Maintain strong support feedback
teachingAssistant.description: Reach an average support feedback score of at least 4.2 out of 5 with the configured minimum response count.

teacher.title: Publish an approved course
teacher.description: Have at least one course approved and published during the active season.

teachingAssistant.title: Meet the support response target
teachingAssistant.description: Meet at least 90% of the response-time target over the configured minimum number of support requests.

teacher.title: Deliver thirty learning sessions
teacher.description: Deliver thirty completed sessions during the active season.

teachingAssistant.title: Support forty learning sessions
teachingAssistant.description: Provide verified support in forty completed sessions during the active season.

teacher.title: Complete advanced teaching certification
teacher.description: Complete one approved advanced teaching or subject-matter certification.

completion.evidenceDescription: Certificate verified by an authorized administrator.

teachingAssistant.title: Complete advanced support certification
teachingAssistant.description: Complete one approved advanced learner-support certification.

completion.evidenceDescription: Certificate verified by an authorized administrator.

teacher.title: Complete peer teaching review
teacher.description: Receive an approved peer review of one course or teaching session.

completion.evidenceDescription: Peer review outcome and reviewer are recorded.

teachingAssistant.title: Complete peer support review
teachingAssistant.description: Receive an approved peer review of learner-support work.

completion.evidenceDescription: Peer review outcome and reviewer are recorded.

teacher.title: Mentor a teaching colleague
teacher.description: Complete one documented mentoring cycle with an approved colleague.

completion.evidenceDescription: Mentoring completion is confirmed by the mentee or program owner.

teachingAssistant.title: Mentor a Teaching Assistant colleague
teachingAssistant.description: Complete one documented mentoring cycle with an approved colleague.

completion.evidenceDescription: Mentoring completion is confirmed by the mentee or program owner.

teacher.title: Contribute to teaching quality
teacher.description: Complete one approved contribution to course quality or teaching practice.

completion.evidenceDescription: Contribution and its impact are reviewed by an authorized administrator.

teachingAssistant.title: Contribute to learner-support quality
teachingAssistant.description: Complete one approved contribution to learner-support quality or practice.

completion.evidenceDescription: Contribution and its impact are reviewed by an authorized administrator.
